title: The Cosmos
description: Public-domain views of deep space from Hubble and the James Webb Space Telescope.

items.title: Pillars of Creation
items.agent_name: SCIENCE: NASA, ESA, CSA, STScI; IMAGE PROCESSING: Joseph DePasquale (STScI), Anton M. Koekemoer (STScI), Alyssa Pagan (STScI)
items.description_narrative: This iconic astronomical image captures towering structures of interstellar gas and dust within the Eagle Nebula, where new stars are actively forming. These "pillars" are dense nurseries sculpted by the intense radiation and stellar winds from massive, hot, young stars.
items.tags: astronomy, nebula, star formation, cosmic, space, scientific, majestic

items.title: Cosmic Cliffs Carina Nebula
items.agent_name: IMAGE: NASA, ESA, CSA, STScI
items.description_narrative: This stunning image captures the dramatic 'Cosmic Cliffs' within the Carina Nebula, a colossal stellar nursery located about 7,600 light-years away. It reveals intricate structures of gas and dust where new stars are actively forming.
items.tags: astronomy, nebula, space, cosmic, carina, star formation, scientific image
items.credit_line: "Cosmic Cliffs" in the Carina Nebula (NIRCam Compass Image)

items.title: Hubble Ultra Deep Field
items.agent_name: NASA and the European Space Agency. Edited by Noodle snacks
items.description_narrative: The Hubble Ultra Deep Field captures a minuscule region of the sky, revealing an estimated 10,000 galaxies, some dating back to just a few hundred million years after the Big Bang. This profound image provides a direct look into the early universe, illustrating billions of years of cosmic evolution.
items.tags: astronomy, deep space, galaxies, scientific imaging, early universe, cosmic, profound, exploration

items.title: Sombrero Galaxy
items.agent_name: NASA/ESA and The Hubble Heritage Team (STScI/AURA)
items.description_narrative: The Sombrero Galaxy (M104) is a spiral galaxy known for its bright nucleus, large central bulge, and a prominent dust lane that appears as a dark band silhouetted against the bulge. This dramatic image captures the galaxy's distinctive hat-like appearance, a visual spectacle of stars, gas, and dust.
items.tags: galaxy, spiral galaxy, astronomy, space, scientific imaging, deep space, cosmic

items.title: Crab Nebula
items.agent_name: NASA, ESA, J. Hester and A. Loll (Arizona State University)
items.description_narrative: The Crab Nebula is a supernova remnant, a luminous cloud of gas and dust resulting from a massive stellar explosion observed in 1054 AD. Energized by a rapidly spinning neutron star at its core, it represents a dynamic and expanding celestial object.
items.tags: nebula, supernova remnant, astronomy, space, scientific imaging, cosmic, star, gas cloud

items.title: Horsehead Nebula
items.agent_name: Taavi Niittee
items.description_narrative: This striking image captures the iconic Horsehead Nebula, a dark nebula forming part of the larger Orion Molecular Cloud Complex. Its distinctive shape, reminiscent of a seahorse's head, is formed by a dense cloud of gas and dust silhouetted against a brighter emission nebula.
items.tags: astronomy, nebula, cosmos, space, astrophotography, celestial, deep space

items.title: Andromeda Galaxy
items.agent_name: NASA, ESA, Benjamin F. Williams (UWashington), Zhuo Chen (UWashington), L. Clifton Johnson (Northwestern); Image Processing: Joseph DePasquale (STScI).[1]
items.description_narrative: This stunning image captures the vast spiral arms of the Andromeda Galaxy, our closest large galactic neighbor. The intricate details visible reveal countless stars and dust lanes, offering a profound glimpse into the cosmos.
items.tags: galaxy, astronomy, space, cosmos, spiral galaxy, celestial, scientific image, universe

items.title: Veil Nebula
items.agent_name: Jose A Mtanous
items.description_narrative: This artwork captures the Veil Nebula, a stunning supernova remnant located in the constellation Cygnus. Its intricate filaments of ionized gas are the expanding debris of a massive star that exploded thousands of years ago.
items.tags: nebula, supernova remnant, astrophotography, space, cosmos, scientific, celestial

items.title: Southern Ring Nebula Webb
items.agent_name: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio - Global Science and Technology, Inc./Amy Moran, STScI/Joseph DePasquale
items.description_narrative: The James Webb Space Telescope reveals the intricate, glowing shell of the Southern Ring Nebula, capturing light from dying stars within. This infrared image unveils layers of gas and dust expanding into space, offering unprecedented detail into stellar evolution.
items.tags: astronomy, nebula, space, cosmic, infrared, scientific visualization, stellar evolution
items.credit_line: The Webb Space Telescope Studies the Southern Ring Nebula

items.agent_name:

items.description_narrative: This stunning image captures Stephan's Quintet, a visual grouping of five galaxies, as observed by the James Webb Space Telescope. It dramatically showcases the intricate dance of galactic interactions and the vibrant processes of star formation in unprecedented detail.
items.tags: galaxies, stephan's quintet, space, astronomy, james webb space telescope, cosmic, scientific imaging, deep space

items.title: Eagle Nebula
items.agent_name: NASA, ESA, and The Hubble Heritage Team (STScI/AURA)
items.description_narrative: The Eagle Nebula, also known as Messier 16, is a young open cluster of stars in the Serpens constellation, renowned for its active star formation. This cosmic landscape features dramatic towering structures of interstellar gas and dust, famously dubbed the 'Pillars of Creation,' where new stars are born.
items.tags: astronomy, nebula, star formation, pillars of creation, space, scientific imaging, cosmos

items.title: Tarantula Nebula Webb
items.agent_name: NASA, ESA, CSA, STScI, Webb ERO Production Team
items.description_narrative: This image reveals the luminous heart of the Tarantula Nebula, a vast region of active star formation located in the Large Magellanic Cloud. Captured by the James Webb Space Telescope, it showcases intricate gas and dust structures, along with countless newly formed stars.
items.tags: nebula, space, astronomy, star formation, cosmic, webb telescope, scientific imaging

items.title: Helix Nebula
items.agent_name: NASA/JPL-Caltech/Univ. of Ariz.
items.description_narrative: The Helix Nebula, also known as 'The Eye of God,' is a striking planetary nebula formed from the expelled gas layers of a dying star. Its vivid colors and intricate structure showcase the final stages of stellar evolution, creating a cosmic spectacle visible from Earth.
items.tags: nebula, planetary nebula, astronomy, space, cosmos, stellar evolution, scientific imagery
items.credit_line: NASA - Comets Kick up Dust in Helix Nebula

items.title: Orion Nebula
items.agent_name: NASA, ESA, M. Robberto (Space Telescope Science Institute/ESA) and the Hubble Space Telescope Orion Treasury Project Team
items.description_narrative: This detailed image captures the turbulent beauty of the Orion Nebula, a stellar nursery where new stars are born. It was meticulously assembled from observations made by the Hubble Space Telescope and various scientific teams.
items.tags: astronomy, nebula, space, star formation, scientific imaging, hubble space telescope, cosmos

items.title: Pinwheel Galaxy
items.agent_name: Taavi Niittee
items.description_narrative: This captivating image presents the Pinwheel Galaxy, a grand spiral formation located in the constellation Ursa Major. Created by Taavi Niittee, the artwork reveals intricate details of its luminous arms and dust lanes.
items.tags: galaxy, astronomy, space, cosmos, celestial, spiral, luminous, deep space

items.title: Antennae Galaxies
items.agent_name: NASA, ESA, and the Hubble Heritage Team (STScI/AURA)-ESA/Hubble Collaboration
items.description_narrative: This striking image captures the Antennae Galaxies, a pair of colliding spiral galaxies undergoing a dramatic cosmic interaction. The intense gravitational forces are triggering the formation of millions of new stars, visible as bright blue regions within the chaotic arms.
items.tags: galaxies, cosmic, collision, astronomy, scientific imaging, hubble, space, digital

items.title: Mystic Mountain
items.agent_name: NASA, ESA, and M. Livio and the Hubble 20th Anniversary Team (STScI)
items.description_narrative: This stunning image, titled 'Mystic Mountain,' reveals a towering pillar of gas and dust within a vibrant star-forming region. Captured by the Hubble Space Telescope, it showcases the dramatic processes of stellar birth and activity in the cosmos.
items.tags: space, nebula, star formation, cosmos, astronomy, hubble, scientific imaging, cosmic landscape

items.title: Butterfly Nebula NGC 6302
items.agent_name: NASA, ESA and the Hubble SM4 ERO Team
items.description_narrative: This vivid image captures the Butterfly Nebula NGC 6302, a planetary nebula characterized by its striking bipolar shape and vibrant colors. The central dying star, hidden by a dense torus of dust, has ejected material that forms the expanding, wing-like structures of superheated gas.
items.tags: nebula, space, astronomy, celestial, gas, dust, cosmic, scientific imaging

items.title: Cartwheel Galaxy Webb
items.agent_name: NASA, ESA, CSA, STScI
items.description_narrative: The Cartwheel Galaxy, a striking ring galaxy, is believed to have formed from a high-speed collision with a smaller galaxy. Captured by the James Webb Space Telescope, this image reveals intricate details of its active star formation and complex dust structures in infrared light.
items.tags: galaxy, ring galaxy, astronomy, space, infrared, cosmos, star formation, telescope
items.credit_line: Cartwheel Galaxy (NIRCam and MIRI Composite Image)

items.title: Cosmic Reef
items.agent_name: , and
items.description_narrative: The artwork titled 'Cosmic Reef' invites contemplation of expansive, otherworldly environments. Its evocative name suggests a merging of deep-sea ecosystems with celestial phenomena.
items.tags: cosmic, reef, abstract, imaginary, fantastical

items.title: Jupiter's Great Red Spot Juno
items.agent_name: NASA/JPL-Caltech/MSSS/SwRI/Kevin M. Gill
items.description_narrative: This image captures the colossal vortex of Jupiter's Great Red Spot, a persistent storm larger than Earth. It was captured by the Juno spacecraft during its close flyby and further processed to enhance its vibrant details.
items.tags: jupiter, great red spot, astronomy, space exploration, planetary science, nasa, scientific visualization, cosmic

items.title: Pluto New Horizons
items.agent_name: NASA/Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory/Southwest Research Institute/Alex Parker
items.description_narrative: This striking image presents Pluto's varied surface, captured during the New Horizons mission's historic flyby. It reveals diverse geological features across the dwarf planet, offering unprecedented detail.
items.tags: space, dwarf planet, pluto, new horizons, planetary science, astronomical image, celestial body
items.credit_line: 10 Years Ago: NASA’s New Horizons Captures Pluto’s Heart

items.title: Curiosity Self-Portrait at Mars
items.agent_name: NASA/JPL-Caltech/MSSS
items.description_narrative: The Curiosity rover, a robotic explorer, captured this intricate self-portrait on Mars using its Mars Hand Lens Imager (MAHLI). This mosaic image showcases the rover's design and its presence against the expansive, desolate Martian landscape.
items.tags: mars, rover, self-portrait, space exploration, scientific imaging, extraterrestrial, robotic art

items.title: Saturn from Cassini
items.agent_name: NASA/JPL/Space Science Institute
items.description_narrative: This striking view captures the gas giant Saturn and its intricate ring system, showcasing the planet's majestic scale and atmospheric details. Captured by the Cassini spacecraft, this image provides a detailed perspective of one of our solar system's most recognizable features.
items.tags: saturn, planet, rings, space, astronomy, scientific, solar system, cosmic
